description.p: Pandabox is a secure, open-source password manager built with Rust, offering robust encryption and a user-friendly interface.

ul.li: Secure password storage using industry-standard encryption
Master password protection with Argon2 key derivation
Optional zero-knowledge sync: the whole vault is sealed as a single encrypted pandabox.pbx file in any folder you choose (Nextcloud, OneDrive, Syncthing, USB stick, …)
File → Cloud Sync page: enable/disable, folder picker, live status, sync now
Restore a vault on a fresh machine from a folder + master password
Conflicts are detected and asked, never overwritten — the losing side is kept as a pandabox.pbx.conflict-… backup copy
Sortable table - click any column header to sort ascending/descending
Menu dropdowns no longer stretch to full window height
Shared RustRover run configuration and pinned toolchain
